proposal.reason: The PR is a substantive expansion of RAS hang diagnostics and offline analysis: it adds Ring forwarding-boundary attribution, richer per-peer/channel validity metadata, new ring backtrace logic, diagnostic snapshot/replay format updates, and monitor/read-safety gating for initialized communicators. Changes in shared files (e.g., init/comm dumper hooks) support this diagnostic behavior rather than introducing independent transport, kernel, or communicator-policy changes.
